Position Summary
We are seeking a meticulous and motivated Data Engineer to join Avanta Analytics, a fast-growing enterprise data team within a global technology services company. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer (0+ years) who wants to design, build and operate reliable, scalable data pipelines and analytical models that power business insights across finance, sales and product analytics. You will work closely with data scientists, analytics engineers, product managers and platform teams to translate data requirements into production-grade ETL/ELT workflows, implement transformations using modern analytics engineering practices, and ensure high data quality and observability. The position is Hybrid: Mumbai or Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Engineering
- Implement, test and maintain batch and near-real-time data ingestion pipelines from internal systems and third-party sources into the enterprise data platform.
- Design and optimize data storage schemas, clustering and partition strategies to maximize query performance and cost efficiency within the cloud data warehouse.
- Collaborate with platform engineers to onboard new data sources and evolve the platform architecture to meet scaling and compliance requirements.

Analytics Engineering and Transformation
- Develop and maintain transformation code and modular data models using dbt following best practices for testing, documentation and version control.
- Build reusable data marts and subject-area models that serve analytics, BI dashboards and machine learning feature stores.
- Implement data quality checks, assertions and automated tests to ensure production data correctness and lineage.

Data Processing and Performance Optimization
- Author and optimize distributed data processing jobs using Apache Spark to process large datasets efficiently.
- Instrument pipelines for performance monitoring, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning (e.g., partitioning, memory management, query rewrite).
- Work on cost and resource optimization initiatives for processing workloads and cloud storage.

Snowflake Data Warehouse Operations
- Manage Snowflake objects including databases, schemas, tables, views, stages and file formats; implement role-based access, masking and secure sharing where required.
- Create and maintain robust data loading patterns into Snowflake (COPY, Snowpipe) and troubleshoot load failures or latency issues.
- Ensure data models and transformations in Snowflake are aligned with downstream consumption patterns and SLAs.

Collaboration, Documentation and Governance
- Partner with data consumers (analytics, product, operations) to gather requirements, prioritize deliverables and translate business questions into data solutions.
- Produce clear documentation of data models, transformation logic, and operational runbooks to support on-call and handover processes.
- Contribute to data governance, cataloging and metadata initiatives to improve discoverability and regulatory compliance.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 0+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering internships, academic projects or equivalent hands-on experience producing data pipelines and transformations.

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Python
- Apache Spark
- Snowflake
- dbt

- Proven ability to write clean, maintainable code and unit/integration tests for data workflows.
- Familiarity with SQL and query optimization techniques.
- Experience using version control (Git) and CI/CD for data projects.
- Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- BigQuery
- Apache Airflow
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) and related managed data services.
- Exposure to data observability tools, metrics instrumentation and alerting for pipelines.
- Prior experience working with BI tools and creating data products for analysts and stakeholders.

Success Metrics
- Pipeline Reliability: Achieve and maintain 99%+ scheduled pipeline success rate and reduce manual interventions or incident severity across the data stack.
- Data Quality: Meet SLA for detection and remediation of data quality issues (e.g., automated tests catch 95%+ of regression defects before release).
- Performance & Cost Efficiency: Improve average query and job runtime for key workloads by measurable percentages (baseline and target set within first 3 months) while reducing unnecessary compute spend.
- Delivery & Impact: Deliver prioritized data models and marts on schedule, with high adoption by downstream analytics teams (usage and dashboard dependency metrics).
- Documentation & On-call Readiness: Maintain complete documentation and runbooks for all owned pipelines; achieve time-to-recovery targets during incidents through clear runbooks and monitoring.

Location and Work Mode
- Hybrid: Mumbai or Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.

Avanta Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. We offer a structured onboarding program, mentorship from senior engineers, and opportunities to work on company-wide initiatives that influence business strategy.
